parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
Good morning everyone. Today we’re looking at urban migration, the movement of people migrating from outside cities into cities. I think it’s easy to jump to the conclusion that a rural lifestyle is greener. However, recent studies have suggested otherwise.

First of all, if we take the land area of the earth, the proportion that cities take up is a mere 3% and these same cities actually produce 30 to 40% of the carbon that is released into the atmosphere, a lower amount than the 60 to 70% from non-urban areas. Anyway, let’s imagine that most people decide to migrate to the city.

What kind of impact would that have? For a start, this movement of people from the countryside should lift the pressure of intensive agriculture from the land allowing forests to regenerate. Another point in favor of urban migration is that it can be far more energy efficient if services are concentrated in the city for example. This is true for electricity and as you can imagine water. Then, once you remember that rural communities are often very spread out, you can see yet another green reason to live in the city. Rural citizens rely on the car to make their journeys far more than city dwellers, who have other more environmentally friendly forms of transport that they can use such as buses and trains. The journeys tend to be shorter too. Yet another point in favor of urban migration is the kind of recycling schemes that can only take place where the population is concentrated. Take, for instance, Seattle in the USA, where methane gas is being put to good use and is generating energy for the city. It’s produced from the city’s rubbish which could not be collected so efficiently from rural areas.

Now another factor that threatens the environment is the growing world population. It’s estimated that 75 million babies are now born every year and in some countries the birth rate shows no signs of slowing down. Urban migration may provide an answer here. Now in cities, one of the reasons that women tend to have fewer children is that they get married later and start their families later. And the reason for this is that it’s far easier to find a job and once you have one, to get a promotion. So yes, the focus isn’t on bearing children.

Well, it would be foolish to pretend that there are no downsides to urban living when clearly there are. The thing that critics often mention is the idea that migrants may end up losing their culture, although some studies have found the opposite is true. Rather than give up their traditions, people actually work hard to maintain them. More evident is the fact that compared to the lower rate that is observed in rural areas, we can see that there is more crime occurring in cities. There won’t be many of us here today who can say we haven’t been directly or indirectly affected by it. There’s another issue that we have to deal with. So many cities, including our own, now suffer from high levels of pollution so that the air we breathe is far from pure. And another factor against the urban is greener idea is that urbanization often drives a country’s economy. Put simply, when there is greater wealth in society, more energy is consumed. One of the direct effects of a stronger economy, something that many citizens will now experience every day and may well find stressful, is the amount of traffic on the road, despite the other options we mentioned earlier. This is a problem that is not about to go away, although there are some solutions that could be considered.

Let’s have a look at some of those.

analyses.content: 演讲者指出城市产生的碳（carbon）占30%到40%，这个数量低于非城市区域的60%到70%。
Speaker: ...these same cities actually produce 30 to 40% of the carbon that is released into the atmosphere, a lower amount than the 60 to 70% from non-urban areas.
听到 "produce... less... than" 的比较结构时，抓住原文中的 "lower amount than" 对应的名词 carbon。
Speaker: For a start, this movement of people from the countryside should lift the pressure of intensive agriculture from the land allowing forests to regenerate.
题目中的 "recover" 对应原文的 "regenerate"，注意不要填成 agriculture（那是压力的来源）。
人口向城市迁移可以减轻对土地的农业压力，从而允许森林（forests）再生。
Speaker: Rural citizens rely on the car to make their journeys far more than city dwellers, who have other more environmentally friendly forms of transport that they can use such as buses and trains.
原文列举了 buses and trains，但题目需要一个概括性名词，对应原文 "forms of transport"。
城市居民拥有比农村居民更环保的交通（transport）形式，如公共汽车和火车。
Speaker: It’s [methane gas] produced from the city’s rubbish which could not be collected so efficiently from rural areas.
题目问甲烷气体来自哪里（from...），原文说 "produced from the city’s rubbish"。
以西雅图为例，能源是从城市的垃圾（rubbish）中产生的甲烷气体转化而来的。
Speaker: And the reason for this is that it’s far easier to find a job and once you have one, to get a promotion.
题目是 "gain promotion"，原文是 "get a promotion"，job 是前提条件，promotion 才是工作后的收益。
在城市更容易找到工作，而且一旦有了工作，更容易获得晋升（promotion）。
批评家经常提到的一点是，移民最终可能会失去他们的文化（culture）。
Speaker: The thing that critics often mention is the idea that migrants may end up losing their culture, although some studies have found the opposite is true.
虽然原文后半句反驳了这个观点（studies have found the opposite），但这道题问的是 "downsides" 和 "possible loss"，所以要填批评家担心的点。
Speaker: More evident is the fact that compared to the lower rate that is observed in rural areas, we can see that there is more crime occurring in cities.
"Higher... rate" 对应原文的 "more crime occurring"。
与农村地区相比，我们可以看到城市中发生的犯罪（crime）更多，即犯罪率更高。
Speaker: So many cities, including our own, now suffer from high levels of pollution so that the air we breathe is far from pure.
题目 "poor quality of the..." 对应原文 "air... is far from pure"，不要填 pollution（那是原因）。
城市遭受高水平污染，导致我们呼吸的空气（air）远非纯净，即质量很差。
Speaker: Put simply, when there is greater wealth in society, more energy is consumed.
题目 "increased wealth" 对应原文 "greater wealth"，economy 是大背景。
经济因素方面，当社会中有更多的财富（wealth）时，就会消耗更多的能源。
Speaker: One of the direct effects of a stronger economy, something that many citizens will now experience every day and may well find stressful, is the amount of traffic on the road.
题目 "quantity of daily..." 对应原文 "amount of traffic"，road 是地点。
许多市民每天都会感到压力很大的一件事是道路上的交通（traffic）数量。
